title: Eye-Strain and Screen-Break Reminder
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=symptom:log type=eyestrain
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as episodes by _time
| eval high=if(episodes>3,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Counts eye-strain episodes each day so a screen-heavy stretch prompts you to follow the twenty-twenty rule.
value: Frequent eye strain is a signal to change habits; tracking it links the discomfort to your screen days.
implementation: Log eye-strain moments into `index=personal`; alert on high-strain days.
visualization: Column chart of daily eye-strain episodes.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how often your eyes feel strained, reminding you to rest them during screen-heavy days.
